piezas.titulo: Reading comprehension: City, climate and planning
texto: Contextual reading of an urban resilience report on climate change: read the technical analysis of stormwater drainage in metropolitan areas. Notice how the engineers justify long-term works, arguing that partial or improvised solutions do not prevent costly floods from recurring.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «การบูรณาการระบบคมนาคมที่เป็นมิตรต่อสิ่งแวดล้อมช่วยลดมลพิษทางอากาศในเมืองหลวง» express?

opciones.texto: Integrating environmentally friendly transport reduces urban air pollution in the capital.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «การบูรณาการระบบคมนาคมที่เป็นมิตรต่อสิ่งแวดล้อมช่วยลดมลพิษทางอากาศในเมืองหลวง» from the text.

opciones.texto: Public participation in urban planning ensures that solutions match real needs.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another complementary statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Assessing environmental risks rigorously points the way towards truly sustainable cities.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.
การระบายน้ำ means «drainage».

pregunta.texto: Read the sentence and choose its meaning.

opciones.explicacion: The translation matches the Thai sentence.

opciones.texto: Good infrastructure helps the city cope with risks.
opciones.explicacion: This is another sentence on the same topic.

opciones.texto: If the drainage is insufficient, flooding will probably happen again.
opciones.explicacion: This sentence expresses a different idea on the same topic.
